t: You are looking at 23 Kensington Place, a building in the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea. It was designed by Tom Kay, a British architect who worked in London. That is about all the material here says about him, so I will not guess at the rest. If you want to understand what Kay did with this building, look at it closely. Take in the front, the proportions and the way it sits among its neighbours on the street.
